name: Maccubus
source:
A prostitute that lived in the Succubus Village before being turned into a Succubus. Succubus is the name given to monsters who have all the traits and qualities befitting one of their family of monster. Maccubus is a special name given to Succubi who already have expert level sexual skills before their transformation.

Already quite skilled in pleasing men, her Succubus transformation drastically increased the quality of the pleasure she is able to bring. In addition, she is now able to employ the famous "Energy Drain" move to suck the energy from men. She's one who is already more powerful than many Succubi, even though just being transformed into one herself.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
